src='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    threshold = 0.7
    candidates = []
    for color in colors:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == color for v in grid[r]) / w >= threshold]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) / h >= threshold]
        if len(rows) >= 2 and len(cols) >= 2:
            candidates.append((len(rows) * len(cols), color, rows, cols))
    _, line, rows, cols = min(candidates)

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rows
                for c in range(w) if c not in cols]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    active_rows = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows)
                   if any(grid[r][c] != line for c in cols)]
    active_cols = [j for j, c in enumerate(cols)
                   if any(grid[r][c] != line for r in rows)]
    r0, r1 = min(active_rows), max(active_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(active_cols), max(active_cols)

    result = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci + 1]],
                       grid[rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci + 1]]]
            out_row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != line and len(set(corners)) == 1 else background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
'''
